If you’re ordering in India and have up to two weeks, I’d shortlist these three. The sweet spot is roughly ₹500–₹1,600: enough personalization to feel thoughtful without paying a big premium just for “custom.”

My ranking
Choice	Typical price	Best for	Main trade-off
1. Personalized metal frame	~₹745	Safe, elegant anniversary gift	Less emotionally unique than a multi-photo gift
2. Couple star-map / personalized art	~₹1,597	More romantic + memorable	Higher price; design quality matters
3. Engraved wooden frame	~₹799	Warm, personal, classic	Can look slightly “gift-shop” depending on engraving

1. Best value: personalized metal/desk frame
Good balance of price, presentation and personalization. I’d choose this if you want something elegant rather than overly romantic.

2. Best emotional value: star-map/personalized artwork
Worth the extra ₹800-ish if you can tie it to a meaningful date/place. It feels more deliberately chosen than simply putting a photo in a frame.

3. Best budget option: engraved wooden frame
Probably the best choice if you have a great couple photo + names/date/message. Personalized wooden frames are commonly around ₹700–₹900, and some sellers offer express delivery within 4–6 days. 
Play Creative

What I'd check before ordering

Actual delivery date to the recipient's pincode — don't rely only on “ships in 2–3 days.” Some personalized sellers quote 3–7 business days, while others can take 7–10 days. 
FotoMandir
+1

Photo quality — use the original high-resolution photo, not a WhatsApp screenshot. 
Nivaraprint

Preview before production — particularly important for text, faces and cropping.

Replacement policy — personalized products generally can't be returned simply because you changed your mind; damage/printing-error replacement is much more useful.

Packaging — especially for acrylic, glass or framed products.

Personalization limit — names + date + one short line usually looks better than a long romantic paragraph.

Express shipping cost — ₹100–₹200 extra is worth it if the standard ETA gets close to your two-week deadline.

If I had to pick just one: I'd go with the personalized wooden/metal frame around ₹700–₹900, and spend the effort on choosing a genuinely good photo and a meaningful one-line message. That usually gives better value than a ₹2,500+ novelty gift.

If you tell me your budget and whether this is for your partner, parents, or another couple, I can narrow it to 3 specific gifts and check delivery options.
